## PR Description

Fixes #2131

MacOS onboarding / networks feedback pass. All four reported items addressed at the root; every behavioral fix carries a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code (proven locally by re-running it against HEAD).

## Delivered

**(4) FUNCTIONAL: opening any file in a mounted session failed ("Could not load file · No such file or directory")** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/widgets/file_browser.dart`
- Root cause: the browser navigates with paths relative to `ExecutionEnv.cwd`; at a live mount that cwd is the virtual `/project`, but subdirectory segments and file-open paths were forwarded bare, so the delegate resolved them against the app-container cwd (`<container>/README.md` — never a real path). The root listing worked (it already carried the `/project` prefix), which is exactly the owner's symptom: files visible, every open failing.
- Fix: the existing mount-namespace special-case now covers non-empty segments and child paths (`/project/<seg>`), gated on a new `envCwdResolvesToMountSegment()` — a cwd-override session (per-chat sandbox folder) keeps plain cwd-relative paths. Fixes file opens, folder drill-downs, and uploads through the browser in mounted sessions.
- Regression tests (`test/file_browser_test.dart`): open-at-mount-root and drill-down-into-subfolder — both fail pre-fix (verified), pass post-fix.

**(3) Mounted-files list not visible in one app state** — `flutter_app/lib/services/project_mount_env.dart`
- Root cause: `resolveProjectMountEnv()` could not see through a `CwdOverrideEnv`. A session created BEFORE a folder was mounted (the shell allocates a per-chat sandbox folder wrapped around the full env stack) kept the mount invisible: no identity chip, `visibleFolderRoot` mount-blind, `pickAndApplyProjectMount` silently no-oped. Now the walker is transparent to cwd overrides, while `SessionCwd.sessionCwd` still scopes such sessions to their own override folder (guarded + tested in `test/project_mount_env_test.dart`).

**(1)+(2) Dark-theme text colors on the start/session screens (shots 1–2: white labels on white pills/bubbles)** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/onboarding_screen.dart` + `onboarding_mockups.dart`
- Eight hardcoded light surfaces carried theme-following ink: user bubble (`_kBubble`), typing bubble, chat-input pill, suggestion pills ("Try these ideas"), Upcoming widget, created-card inner pill, Later chips, timeline chip. All now use the theme surface tokens (`_onbCard` / `surface2`); `_kBubble` removed. Dark mode reads correctly on every mockup; light goldens shift only where the palette's surface differs from the hardcoded near-whites.
- GOLDEN TESTS: `onboarding_golden_test.dart` snapshots regenerated (12 PNGs) and every one opened and eyeballed — no tofu, no overflow; `golden_guard_test.dart` map already covers both files (no map change needed).

**Networks: empty state needs a sign-in entry; networks persist after sign-out**
- `ChatNetworksPanel` empty state now offers **Join your first network** (manage dialog) and **Sign in** (sign-in dialog, hidden while signed in) — mirroring the management sidebar's empty state; new golden `chats_networks_empty` in `rail_golden_test.dart`.
- `KeyWallet.clearAccount()` now purges account-synced (passwordless) memberships so the signed-out list no longer shows the account's networks; guest joins carrying their credential stay. Regression test fails pre-fix (verified).

## Housekeeping
- Deleted the orphan `wide_layout_shell_duo_overflow.png` — pre-existing on main (its test was removed upstream in #2092), hard-fails `scripts/check_goldens.py` for every commit.
- `pubspec.lock` / `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.swift` churn from the local standalone-SDK tooling reverted — not part of the fix.

## Gates (standalone Flutter SDK in-worktree, TZ=UTC)
- `flutter analyze`: no issues in touched files (112 pre-existing package infos untouched).
- `dart format` clean on all touched files.
- Targeted: file_browser (69), project_mount_env (12), key_wallet + networks_list_panel + account_network_sync (47), project_mount + env_factory_io + wide_layout_shell_actions (118) — all green.
- Golden: `check_goldens.py` exit 0 (full `test/golden` suite + orphan check), `golden_guard_test.dart`, `l10n_guard_test.dart`, `files_golden_test.dart` green.

## Remaining (not addressed, why)
- The "no channels matched to this filter" string stays a plain search-empty (it is a filter empty-state, not a sign-in dead end; the sign-in entry point now sits one level up on the networks root).
- Agent-tool reads with bare relative paths inside a mounted session still resolve container-side (the browser was the reported surface; the `_map`-level change would have re-routed container-relative consumers — apps/skills stores — and was deliberately not taken). Worth a follow-up if it bites.

# Review Policy

Preset: `default` — resolved from: built-in default (resolution chain: projectConfig.reviewPolicy → workflow jobParams → built-in default).
Verification: `none` — findings post exactly as the review leg raised them — no second-stage verification.
Every verdict on this PR is traceable to this table.

| Severity | Round | Fix | Gates approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🚨 BLOCKING | rework | mandatory | YES |
| ⚠️ IMPORTANT | rework | mandatory | YES |
| 💡 SUGGESTION | polish | mandatory | no |
| 🪶 NIT | none | opportunistic | no |

Verification: `none` — findings post exactly as the review leg raised them — no second-stage verification.

Bounds: polishMaxThreads=6 · polishMaxChangedLines=80 · opportunisticMaxThreads=8 · opportunisticSameFilesOnly=true · densityMin=2 · densityMax=8 · sweepBatch=10 · sweepMaxAgeDays=30

Density cap (💡/🪶 threads only; 🚨/⚠️ never capped): allowed = clamp(round(2 + 3*sqrt(additions/200)), 2, 8).
Rank your findings and post the top-K as threads; the overflow becomes a ranked digest list in the general comment. The census counts posted threads + digest lines.

Machine enforcement: the approval is recomputed from the severity census + this policy — the model verdict is advisory. Any 🚨 or ⚠️ open → REQUEST_CHANGES; only 💡/🪶 → APPROVE.
## Downgrade protocol

A rework lap may downgrade a specific ⚠️ IMPORTANT finding to 💡 SUGGESTION **only with a written justification** in the census (the thread reply and the response summary: why this is not maintainability debt). A silent downgrade does not exist: the next review round re-raises it as ⚠️ IMPORTANT and the cycle repeats. A justified downgrade lets a false-⚠️ review converge to APPROVE without a code change.

# pr-2135: fix(2131): mounted-session file opens, mount visibility, onboarding dark theme, networks entry points

## Description

Fixes #2131

MacOS onboarding / networks feedback pass. All four reported items addressed at the root; every behavioral fix carries a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code (proven locally by re-running it against HEAD).

## Delivered

**(4) FUNCTIONAL: opening any file in a mounted session failed ("Could not load file · No such file or directory")** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/widgets/file_browser.dart`
- Root cause: the browser navigates with paths relative to `ExecutionEnv.cwd`; at a live mount that cwd is the virtual `/project`, but subdirectory segments and file-open paths were forwarded bare, so the delegate resolved them against the app-container cwd (`<container>/README.md` — never a real path). The root listing worked (it already carried the `/project` prefix), which is exactly the owner's symptom: files visible, every open failing.
- Fix: the existing mount-namespace special-case now covers non-empty segments and child paths (`/project/<seg>`), gated on a new `envCwdResolvesToMountSegment()` — a cwd-override session (per-chat sandbox folder) keeps plain cwd-relative paths. Fixes file opens, folder drill-downs, and uploads through the browser in mounted sessions.
- Regression tests (`test/file_browser_test.dart`): open-at-mount-root and drill-down-into-subfolder — both fail pre-fix (verified), pass post-fix.

**(3) Mounted-files list not visible in one app state** — `flutter_app/lib/services/project_mount_env.dart`
- Root cause: `resolveProjectMountEnv()` could not see through a `CwdOverrideEnv`. A session created BEFORE a folder was mounted (the shell allocates a per-chat sandbox folder wrapped around the full env stack) kept the mount invisible: no identity chip, `visibleFolderRoot` mount-blind, `pickAndApplyProjectMount` silently no-oped. Now the walker is transparent to cwd overrides, while `SessionCwd.sessionCwd` still scopes such sessions to their own override folder (guarded + tested in `test/project_mount_env_test.dart`).

**(1)+(2) Dark-theme text colors on the start/session screens (shots 1–2: white labels on white pills/bubbles)** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/onboarding_screen.dart` + `onboarding_mockups.dart`
- Eight hardcoded light surfaces carried theme-following ink: user bubble (`_kBubble`), typing bubble, chat-input pill, suggestion pills ("Try these ideas"), Upcoming widget, created-card inner pill, Later chips, timeline chip. All now use the theme surface tokens (`_onbCard` / `surface2`); `_kBubble` removed. Dark mode reads correctly on every mockup; light goldens shift only where the palette's surface differs from the hardcoded near-whites.
- GOLDEN TESTS: `onboarding_golden_test.dart` snapshots regenerated (12 PNGs) and every one opened and eyeballed — no tofu, no overflow; `golden_guard_test.dart` map already covers both files (no map change needed).

**Networks: empty state needs a sign-in entry; networks persist after sign-out**
- `ChatNetworksPanel` empty state now offers **Join your first network** (manage dialog) and **Sign in** (sign-in dialog, hidden while signed in) — mirroring the management sidebar's empty state; new golden `chats_networks_empty` in `rail_golden_test.dart`.
- `KeyWallet.clearAccount()` now purges account-synced (passwordless) memberships so the signed-out list no longer shows the account's networks; guest joins carrying their credential stay. Regression test fails pre-fix (verified).

## Housekeeping
- Deleted the orphan `wide_layout_shell_duo_overflow.png` — pre-existing on main (its test was removed upstream in #2092), hard-fails `scripts/check_goldens.py` for every commit.
- `pubspec.lock` / `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.swift` churn from the local standalone-SDK tooling reverted — not part of the fix.

## Gates (standalone Flutter SDK in-worktree, TZ=UTC)
- `flutter analyze`: no issues in touched files (112 pre-existing package infos untouched).
- `dart format` clean on all touched files.
- Targeted: file_browser (69), project_mount_env (12), key_wallet + networks_list_panel + account_network_sync (47), project_mount + env_factory_io + wide_layout_shell_actions (118) — all green.
- Golden: `check_goldens.py` exit 0 (full `test/golden` suite + orphan check), `golden_guard_test.dart`, `l10n_guard_test.dart`, `files_golden_test.dart` green.

## Remaining (not addressed, why)
- The "no channels matched to this filter" string stays a plain search-empty (it is a filter empty-state, not a sign-in dead end; the sign-in entry point now sits one level up on the networks root).
- Agent-tool reads with bare relative paths inside a mounted session still resolve container-side (the browser was the reported surface; the `_map`-level change would have re-routed container-relative consumers — apps/skills stores — and was deliberately not taken). Worth a follow-up if it bites.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `tools/fa-clip/` — the native macOS pasteboard helper (gh-2040): a plain
  `NSPasteboard` reader (`fa-clip <png|jpeg|tiff>` → bytes on stdout, exit
  2 = flavor absent), built by `scripts/build_fa_clip.sh` into the macOS
  CLI bundles (`bundle/bin/fa-clip`, per-arch) and shipped beside the `fa`
  binary — install.sh, install_local.sh and the self-update swap all copy
  it. The CLI resolves it relative to its own executable, never PATH; a
  missing/broken helper degrades to the named pasteboard-unavailable path.
  NEVER reintroduce the AppleScript/Apple Events clipboard transport
  (`osascript` is grep-gated out of `bin/` + `lib/src/cli/` —
  test/cli/fa_clip_helper_test.dart); the TCC «access data from other
  apps» dialog class must stay dead. macOS text reads stay on `pbpaste`
  (already prompt-free — documented split, gh-2040 AC4).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent

# pr-2135: fix(2131): mounted-session file opens, mount visibility, onboarding dark theme, networks entry points

## Description

Fixes #2131

MacOS onboarding / networks feedback pass. All four reported items addressed at the root; every behavioral fix carries a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code (proven locally by re-running it against HEAD).

## Delivered

**(4) FUNCTIONAL: opening any file in a mounted session failed ("Could not load file · No such file or directory")** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/widgets/file_browser.dart`
- Root cause: the browser navigates with paths relative to `ExecutionEnv.cwd`; at a live mount that cwd is the virtual `/project`, but subdirectory segments and file-open paths were forwarded bare, so the delegate resolved them against the app-container cwd (`<container>/README.md` — never a real path). The root listing worked (it already carried the `/project` prefix), which is exactly the owner's symptom: files visible, every open failing.
- Fix: the existing mount-namespace special-case now covers non-empty segments and child paths (`/project/<seg>`), gated on a new `envCwdResolvesToMountSegment()` — a cwd-override session (per-chat sandbox folder) keeps plain cwd-relative paths. Fixes file opens, folder drill-downs, and uploads through the browser in mounted sessions.
- Regression tests (`test/file_browser_test.dart`): open-at-mount-root and drill-down-into-subfolder — both fail pre-fix (verified), pass post-fix.

**(3) Mounted-files list not visible in one app state** — `flutter_app/lib/services/project_mount_env.dart`
- Root cause: `resolveProjectMountEnv()` could not see through a `CwdOverrideEnv`. A session created BEFORE a folder was mounted (the shell allocates a per-chat sandbox folder wrapped around the full env stack) kept the mount invisible: no identity chip, `visibleFolderRoot` mount-blind, `pickAndApplyProjectMount` silently no-oped. Now the walker is transparent to cwd overrides, while `SessionCwd.sessionCwd` still scopes such sessions to their own override folder (guarded + tested in `test/project_mount_env_test.dart`).

**(1)+(2) Dark-theme text colors on the start/session screens (shots 1–2: white labels on white pills/bubbles)** — `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/onboarding_screen.dart` + `onboarding_mockups.dart`
- Eight hardcoded light surfaces carried theme-following ink: user bubble (`_kBubble`), typing bubble, chat-input pill, suggestion pills ("Try these ideas"), Upcoming widget, created-card inner pill, Later chips, timeline chip. All now use the theme surface tokens (`_onbCard` / `surface2`); `_kBubble` removed. Dark mode reads correctly on every mockup; light goldens shift only where the palette's surface differs from the hardcoded near-whites.
- GOLDEN TESTS: `onboarding_golden_test.dart` snapshots regenerated (12 PNGs) and every one opened and eyeballed — no tofu, no overflow; `golden_guard_test.dart` map already covers both files (no map change needed).

**Networks: empty state needs a sign-in entry; networks persist after sign-out**
- `ChatNetworksPanel` empty state now offers **Join your first network** (manage dialog) and **Sign in** (sign-in dialog, hidden while signed in) — mirroring the management sidebar's empty state; new golden `chats_networks_empty` in `rail_golden_test.dart`.
- `KeyWallet.clearAccount()` now purges account-synced (passwordless) memberships so the signed-out list no longer shows the account's networks; guest joins carrying their credential stay. Regression test fails pre-fix (verified).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: sign-out purge keys on an inferred identity — `password == null` ⇔ account-synced**

```dart
final synced = _networks.entries
    .where((e) => e.value.password == null)
    .map((e) => e.key)
    .toList();
```

I verified the invariant holds on every current producer: the join sheet refuses an empty password (`join_sheet.dart:130-132`), `NetworkSessionManager.join`/`createNetwork` always record one, and `syncAccountNetworks` inserts passwordless while preserving any stored password. So today the purge is correct, and the gh-2131 behavior (signed-out list no longer shows account networks, guest joins stay) is right.

The debt: the criterion is convention-only, spread across four producer sites, and the failure mode is destructive — one future passwordless join path (e.g. open networks with no credential) would make **sign-out silently delete the user's memberships *and* their channel keys** (`_channels.removeWhere((key, _) => key.startsWith('$id/'))`), irrecoverable from the wallet. The doc comment has to argue the equivalence in prose, which is the smell.

Cheap hardening: carry the fact in the data model instead of inferring it — e.g. a `NetworkEntry.synced` flag (or a `KeyWallet.isAccountSynced(id)` helper maintained at insert time), so `clearAccount` purges exactly what `syncAccountNetworks` wrote. Not asking for a behavior change — the behavior is correct; pin the invariant so the next producer can't quietly break it.

💡 **SUGGESTION: the fourth hand-rolled stack walker — extract one shared unwrapping helper**

`project_mount_env.dart` now holds four near-identical decorator-stack walkers, each with its own decorator list and the same `depth < 8` cap:

- `resolveProjectMountEnv()` (Secrets → SessionVars → **CwdOverride** ← added here)
- `projectMountBackendAvailable()` (same three ← CwdOverride added here)
- `SessionCwd.sessionCwd` (two unwrapped, CwdOverride short-circuits ← added here)
- `envCwdResolvesToMountSegment()` (new — copies the same list again)

This PR is the demonstration of the cost: one new decorator (`CwdOverrideEnv`) required three coordinated edits plus a fresh copy of the list in the new helper. The next decorator (or a missed site) is exactly how gh-2131-class "invisible wrapper" bugs happen — `sessionCwd` already diverges subtly (it doesn't unwrap `CwdOverrideEnv` before the mount check, it short-circuits, and that's load-bearing).

Consider one `ExecutionEnv unwrapDecorators(ExecutionEnv)` (unwraps Secrets/SessionVars/CwdOverride with the shared depth cap) and express all four on top of it; each walker keeps only its distinct terminal rule. Pure refactor, no behavior change intended — happy to see it in a follow-up if you'd rather keep this PR focused.

## Review summary — PR #2135 (`fix/2131-macos-boarding-fx` → `main`)

**Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES** — census: 🚨×2 · ⚠️×1 · 💡×1 · 🪶×1 (digest).

**🚨 BLOCKING 1 — the mounted-session fix stops at the mount root.** `_envPath` prefixes subdirectory navigation with `/project`, but `_childPath`'s non-empty-segments branch (`file_browser.dart:396`) does not. At a live mount, `ProjectMountEnv._map` only rewrites `/project…` paths, so bare `src/nested.txt` falls through to the container delegate (`LocalFileSystem._resolve` → `<container>/src/nested.txt`). I proved it on this exact head with the PR's own test rig: drill into `src` works (listing fixed), tapping `nested.txt` renders **"Could not load file"** (`error-shown=true, body-shown=false`), and an upload from the subfolder **silently succeeds into the app container**, never reaching the project folder. The gh-2131 contract ("opening *any file* in a mounted session") and the PR's "fixes file opens … and uploads" claim hold only at the mount root; the new regression tests assert listings only. One-line fix + two missing test assertions in `comment1.md`.

**🚨 BLOCKING 2 — CI red on head `59825cfe`.** PTY/CLI integration shard 2/3: `resume_tail_grid_pty_test.dart` failed to *load* ("Connection closed before full header"), 129 tests green. Unrelated to this `flutter_app/`-only diff and looks like the known PTY-load flake — re-run to confirm, fix/quarantine per gh-1199 AC6 if it reproduces (`comment5_ci.md`).

**⚠️ IMPORTANT — `clearAccount`'s purge infers "account-synced" from `password == null`.** Verified sound on every current producer (join sheet enforces non-empty password; sync inserts passwordless, preserves stored), but the convention-only invariant spans four producer sites and its failure mode silently deletes memberships + channel keys on sign-out. Suggested a tracked `NetworkEntry.synced` flag (`comment2.md`).

**Digest**: the fourth hand-rolled stack walker in `project_mount_env.dart` (`CwdOverrideEnv` had to be added to 3 walkers + a new copy — extract one shared unwrap helper); `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.swift` import-order churn the PR description claims was reverted (reproduced: local `flutter pub get` flips it back).

Everything else checked clean: override-transparency walker correct + tested, onboarding dark-theme token swap consistent with regenerated goldens, networks empty state uses existing l10n keys, orphan golden removal verified. Locally re-verified: 93 targeted tests green, `dart format` clean, `analyze` shows only pre-existing infos.
